display.title: Keep Chanukah All Year: The Lights Say 'Here Comes Moshiach'
display.summary_short: A short Chanukah message: the spirit of Chanukah should stay with us all year, reminding us that Hashem works miracles and can bring Moshiach right now.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given during Chanukah. Uncle Yossi asks the children to keep the memories of Chanukah with them long after the eight days are over, so that they keep bringing warmth, light and inspiration. The Chanukah brachah says that just as Hashem made miracles in those days, He makes miracles at this time too. Hashem can do anything: He can end the galus and send Moshiach at once to bring everyone back to Eretz Yisroel. For this, every soldier of Tzivos Hashem needs firm trust and faith in Hashem, and that is exactly what the flickering flames of the menorah whisper: here comes Moshiach. Uncle Yossi ends with the hope that it will be very soon, because everybody wants Moshiach now.
display.lesson: Let the light of Chanukah stay with you all year, with firm trust that Hashem can bring Moshiach at any moment.
